name: Code Editors & IDEs
description: Tools for writing and editing code, offering syntax highlighting, debugging, etc.

name: Syntax Highlighting
description: Tools designed to improve syntax highlighting.

name: Libraries
description: Files that carry the palette itself into another program.

name: CLI Tools
description: Command-line utilities, from file listings to system monitors.

name: Terminals
description: Programs providing text-based interfaces to interact with the operating system.

name: System
description: Applications that are close to the operating system, and scheme formats that theme many apps at once.

name: Desktop Environments
description: Graphical User Interfaces providing a complete experience for interacting with the operating system.

name: Window Managers
description: Applications that control the placement and appearance of windows in a GUI.

name: Browsers
description: Applications for accessing and navigating the World Wide Web.

name: Photo & Video
description: Applications for viewing and editing photos and video.

name: Note Taking
description: Applications for writing, organising and linking notes.

name: Analytics
description: Tools that monitor or visualise data and system state.
